verbatim:
Immersive LAB catalyses research, training, and community projects around immersive technologies. Virtual Vinci, our student-led association, joins forces with the Vision & Immersion research group to turn the Immersive Lab into a collaborative platform for prototyping, sharing best practices, and showcasing the Pole's expertise.

The initiative combines learning paths for students, applied experimentation with industry partners, and a roadmap for responsible XR adoption across education, health, and smart industry domains.
